languages.english-overview: CanvasCore is a block-based website builder that publishes plain static pages. Build pages visually, publish them as fast HTML files, and keep editing from your browser. No MySQL database is needed.
languages.english-features: Visual block editor, collections and blog, forms, menus, popups, multilingual sites, roles and review, template library, signed one-click updates, whole-site backups.
languages.english-site_name_exp: Shown in the browser tab and in search results. You can change it later in Global Options.
languages.english-starter_exp: A ready-made homepage, created as a draft for you to edit and publish.
languages.english-ad_name_exp: 3 to 32 characters. Choose one that is hard to guess (not admin).
languages.english-ad_email_exp: Where contact form messages are sent.
languages.english-err_pass: The password must have at least 8 characters, and not be admin or the username.
languages.english-err_user: The username must have 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash, underscore or @.
languages.english-err_php: CanvasCore needs PHP 8.0 or newer, with the pdo_sqlite, dom, json and session extensions.
